title: Put a hands-on fundraising team behind your station.
intro: Catapult brings staffed donor engagement, prospect research, coaching and training together to help your station carry the work forward.

rows.catapult: Add experienced Engagement Officers who personally engage donors, steward relationships and make asks within your program, with donor interests documented and qualified prospects coordinated with your team.
rows.veritus: Trains and manages your mid-level staff, with donor strategy, activity tracking and accountability. Engagement Officer staffing and outsourced donor solicitation are not listed in its published mid-level service.

rows.catapult: Turn donor insight into action. Catapult carries out cultivation and asks within your engagement program, with qualified major-gift handoffs so your station can build on the relationship.
rows.veritus: Helps structure major-gift portfolios and coaches and manages your fundraisers as they develop donor relationships.

rows.catapult: Give your team in-depth donor profiles and clear prospect priorities, so it can focus its time on your station’s strongest major-gift opportunities.
rows.veritus: Major-gift prospect research is not listed among its published services; the focus is donor qualification and portfolio strategy.

rows.catapult: Prepare for your next donor conversation with practical cultivation and solicitation coaching, backed by the engagement insights and prospect research your team needs.
rows.veritus: Weekly training, coaching and accountability for major-gift staff, plus individual and group coaching.

rows.catapult: Build fundraising confidence with Everyone is a Fundraiser, Making The Ask, and What to Say When, plus customized training and a two-day Fundraising Bootcamp.
rows.veritus: Veritus Group Academy courses, fundraising certifications and customized organizational training.

note: Based on Catapult's offering and Veritus Group's public service descriptions reviewed November 20, 2026. Describes published service models, not every possible engagement. Scope is agreed with each firm.
